prompt: A café plots daily hot chocolate sales against the outdoor temperature. On warmer days, fewer hot chocolates are sold. What is the direction of the association?

choices.label: It cannot be determined without the data

hint: Ask: as $x$ (temperature) goes UP, does $y$ (sales) go up or down?

hints.text: Ask: as $x$ (temperature) goes UP, does $y$ (sales) go up or down?
Warmer days bring lower sales, so the points slope downhill from left to right.
Downhill means a negative association: choice B.

explanation: Direction describes what happens to $y$ as $x$ increases across the scatterplot.
Here sales FALL as temperature rises, so the cloud of points trends downward from left to right.
A downward trend is a negative association, which is choice B.

alternativeExplanations.title: Two sample days
steps: A cold day, say $30^\circ$, might sell 60 hot chocolates: point $(30, 60)$.
A warm day, say $80^\circ$, might sell 10: point $(80, 10)$.
Moving right from the first point to the second, you move down. Negative.
